scenes.text: Claude built a status page with one strict rule. Uptime comes from a log that's never edited. So forty-two minutes of API outage shows as ninety-nine point nine six percent.

The test build found fifty-eight gaps. A hidden component could still set the banner for the whole page. And a cached page could show a subscriber's email to the next visitor. All fifty-eight are fixed.
Statuspage is free for a hundred subscribers. But subscribing to single components starts at three hundred and ninety-nine dollars a month. If that's what you need, build your own.
